summary: Idols are not to be compared with the Lord—He alone is God and will save Israel.
meta_description: Idols are not to be compared with the Lord—He alone is God and will save Israel.

footnotes.note1_a: Bel and Nebo are idol-gods. Jer. 50:2.
footnotes.note1_b: IE Instead of idols helping man, man has to carry them.
